params.goal: Create an executive-level Company Dossier page for the user's company.

Create an executive-level company KPIs and internal KPIs, all the KPI metric not necesserly need to be available, some KPI metric will be estimated based on industry standards and company profile. This has two goals, one to assess compnay health and performance from diffrent perspectives, second is to create an executive-level company KPIs and internal KPIs presentation, that company should be looking to improve its operations. For example, burn-rate if it's startup company or similar. It should also have main title as 'Executive Company KPIs and Internal KPIs' and should not have any hero section, only metrics section for internal and external KPIs and Make sure YOU ALWAYS OUTPUT recomendation as bullet points AND last bit include this text as well make note that ALL figures are not representavite just acts as placeholder for actual figures or estimation.

Create an executive-level company Analytics dashboard featuring 4 to 8 relevant MUI charts (e.g., revenue growth, customer acquisition, churn, burn rate, or unit economics) tailored to the user's company and industry. Data can be realistic estimates based on industry benchmarks. ALWAYS output an executive summary below the charts formatted as concise bullet points.  At the very end, include the exact note: 'All figures are placeholders/estimations and are not representative of actual figures.'

Search the web and create an executive-level dashboard tailored strictly to the user's industry and company type (e.g., startups). Structure the dashboard into two distinct sections: 1) 'Industry News & Updates' (recent news, press releases, and announcements with publication dates) and 2) 'Upcoming Events & Conferences' (relevant industry conferences, summits, and meetups with event dates). Curate 10 to 20 total credible sources across these sections. ALWAYS output summaries under each section as bullet points. EVERY bullet point MUST contain a direct, clickable Markdown link to the source URL (e.g. [Source Name](url)), along with the date and source headline. ONLY USE DATA FROM CREDIBLE NEWS SITES, OFFICIAL EVENT PAGES, AND PRESS RELEASES. HERO IS NOT NEEDED.
Bootstrap company knowledge base and scrape documentation. Also search how company solution compare to competitors.
